# citation-checker

> Check that each claim in a generated answer is supported by the passages it cites, with deterministic lexical and numeric checks and an optional LLM judge for borderline claims Python package `trysac-citation-checker`, import name `citation_checker`, MIT licensed,
> Python >= 3.10, no runtime dependencies.
